newsitem.title: USA: SOCCER-EASTERN CONFERENCE WINS MLS ALL-STAR GAME.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-EASTERN CONFERENCE WINS MLS ALL-STAR GAME.

text.p: The Eastern Conference beat the Western Conference 5-4 (halftime 2-0 Western Conference) in the Major League Soccer All-Star Game at Giants Stadium on Wednesday night.
Western - Dante Washington (11th, Jorge Campos (43rd), Digital Takawira (80th), Cobi Jones (86th)
Eastern - Carlos Valderrama (50th), Giuseppe Galderisi (63rd), Robert Warzycha (66th), Richie Williams (70th), Brian McBride (88th)
